name: AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 product page (Wayback capture 2020-01-21, spec table)
notes: Live amd.com URL no longer serves this product. Transcribed from the Wayback capture of the AMD product-page spec table: Compute Units 56, Stream Processors 3584, Texture Units 256, Transistor Count 12.5 B, Typical Board Power (Desktop) 210 W, Memory Speed (Effective) 1.6 Gbps, Max Memory Size 8 GB, Memory Type (GPU) HBM2, Memory Interface 2048-bit, Max. Memory Bandwidth 410 GB/s, Launch Date Q3/2017. 1.6 Gbps times 2048-bit divided by 8 equals 409.6 GB/s, consistent with the printed 410 GB/s. The compute-performance rows of this capture were not transcribed in this pass, so no flops rows are recorded. No sparsity footnote is printed.
